question: List building names, their height, street address, city, state, postal code, their gross and assignable square footage, the smallest and largest floor level and the total area of all rooms for each building key.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE building_master AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        b.building_key,
        b.building_number,
        b.building_name,
        b.building_street_address,
        b.bldg_gross_square_footage,
        b.bldg_assignable_square_footage
    FROM beaver."buildings" b
), h AS (
    SELECT 
        fb.building_number,
        MAX(fb.building_height) AS building_height
    FROM beaver."fac_building" fb
    GROUP BY fb.building_number
), h2 AS (
    SELECT 
        fcb.building_number,
        MAX(fcb.building_height) AS building_height
    FROM beaver."fclt_building" fcb
    GROUP BY fcb.building_number
)
SELECT 
    base.building_key,
    base.building_number,
    base.building_name,
    base.building_street_address,
    base.bldg_gross_square_footage,
    base.bldg_assignable_square_footage,
    COALESCE(h.building_height, h2.building_height) AS building_height
FROM base
LEFT JOIN h ON h.building_number = base.building_number
LEFT JOIN h2 ON h2.building_number = base.building_number

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE building_address AS
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ba.building_key,
        ba.street_number,
        ba.pre_directional,
        ba.street_name,
        ba.street_suffix,

        CAST(ba.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
        CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ba.address_purpose,'')) = 'STREET' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS purpose_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ba.building_key ORDER BY 
            CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ba.address_purpose,'')) = 'STREET' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
            ba.warehouse_load_date DESC NULLS LAST,

        ) AS rn

)

FROM ranked

# Compute per-building summary joining master, preferred address, min/max floor, and total room area
from math import isnan

# Build a canonical street_address text from address components
addr_sql = '''
WITH addr_pref AS (
  SELECT 
    building_key,
    street_number,
    pre_directional,
    street_name,
    street_suffix,
    post_directional,
    city,
    state,
    postal_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY building_key ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(city),'')<>'' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(state),'')<>'' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS rn
  FROM building_address
)
SELECT 
  building_key,
  TRIM(
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      NULLIF(TRIM(street_number),''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(pre_directional),''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(street_name),''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(street_suffix),''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(post_directional),'')
    )
  ) AS street_address,
  city,
  state,
  CAST(postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code
FROM addr_pref
WHERE rn=1
'''
addr_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, addr_sql)
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, addr_df, "_addr_pick")

# Floors: compute min/max using numeric level_id if available; else use MIN/MAX on floor as text
floors_sql = '''
WITH lvl AS (
  SELECT building_key,
         MIN(level_id) AS min_level_id,
         MAX(level_id) AS max_level_id,
         MIN(floor) AS min_floor_txt,
         MAX(floor) AS max_floor_txt,
         COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM building_floors
  GROUP BY building_key
), chosen AS (
  SELECT building_key,
         CASE WHEN min_level_id IS NOT NULL THEN min_level_id ELSE NULL END AS min_level_id,
         CASE WHEN max_level_id IS NOT NULL THEN max_level_id ELSE NULL END AS max_level_id,
         min_floor_txt,
         max_floor_txt
  FROM lvl
)
SELECT 
  c.building_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(min_level_id AS VARCHAR), min_floor_txt) AS min_floor,
  COALESCE(CAST(max_level_id AS VARCHAR), max_floor_txt) AS max_floor
FROM chosen c
'''
floors_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, floors_sql)
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, floors_df, "_floor_range")

# Rooms: total area per building
rooms_sql = '''
SELECT building_key, SUM(area) AS total_room_area
FROM building_rooms
GROUP BY building_key
'''
rooms_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, rooms_sql)
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, rooms_df, "_room_totals")

# Join all pieces and create final preview table
final_sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  m.building_key,
  m.building_name,
  m.building_street_address,
  a.street_address AS street_address_components,
  a.city,
  a.state,
  a.postal_code,
  m.bldg_gross_square_footage AS gross_sqft,
  m.bldg_assignable_square_footage AS assignable_sqft,
  m.building_height,
  f.min_floor,
  f.max_floor,
  r.total_room_area
FROM building_master m
LEFT JOIN _addr_pick a USING(building_key)
LEFT JOIN _floor_range f USING(building_key)
LEFT JOIN _room_totals r USING(building_key)
ORDER BY m.building_key
LIMIT 200
'''
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, final_sql)
